examples.arabic: كل يوم بنصحى بدري عشان نخطط للفرح الكبير
examples.english: Every day we wake up early to plan for the big wedding.
examples.transliteration: Koll yōm bansaa badry ʿashān nokhaṭṭeṭ lel-faraḥ el-kabīr.

examples.arabic: فرح اختي بكرة واحنا مبسوطين اوي
examples.english: My sister's wedding is tomorrow and we are very happy.
examples.transliteration: farah okhty bokra we ehna mabsoteen awy

examples.english: The wedding is big and the dress is pretty

examples.arabic: هما بيروحو يشوفو قاعه عشان فرح مصري
examples.english: They go to see a wedding hall for an Egyptian wedding.
examples.transliteration: homma beyrouhou yeshoufou qaa'a ashan farah masri

examples.english: I want us to make a big wedding.
We are now preparing for the wedding.
